related.title: 航空渦扇引擎剖面解讀
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「腔體與等效頸部共振」推進到「共振帶寬的解析需求」，最後以「無流教學結果的外推邊界交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Cavity and effective-neck resonance through Resolving resonance bandwidth to Handoff of no-flow extrapolation limits. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 航空引擎短艙降噪襯層
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「腔體與等效頸部共振」推進到「共振帶寬的解析需求」，最後以「無流教學結果的外推邊界交接」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Cavity and effective-neck resonance through Resolving resonance bandwidth to Handoff of no-flow extrapolation limits. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「連結短艙襯層幾何、阻抗與可驗證的吸聲結果」為主線，在無掠流腔體聲學與合成襯層資料台中依序完成腔體與等效頸部共振、聲壓與量測基準、共振帶寬的解析需求、雙麥克風同步取樣、同一相位差量測的誤差來源及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Link nacelle-liner geometry, impedance and verifiable absorption in a No-flow cavity acoustics and synthetic liner-data bench, progressing through Cavity and effective-neck resonance, Pressure and measurement reference, Resolving resonance bandwidth, Synchronized two-microphone sampling, Error sources in one phase-difference measurement, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
